knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic discount records
knowledge.detail: Three fictional pricing signals capture suppliers, categories, terms, spend, thresholds, gaps, review dates, and evidence sources.

knowledge.name: Demand and timing evidence
knowledge.detail: Two facility-demand candidates and a fixed Northstar, MedSupply, and CareTech review sequence ground sourcing-review briefs.

knowledge.name: Discount Finder rules and skills
knowledge.detail: Two uploaded knowledge files and four operation skills define routing, calculations, validation checks, and commercial guardrails.

intelligence_processing.name: Savings-opportunity scan
intelligence_processing.detail: Surfaces DISC-101 through DISC-103 with exact contract evidence, thresholds, and gaps while labeling them review candidates.

intelligence_processing.name: Dated pricing review
intelligence_processing.detail: Orders renewal, volume-tier, and price-change signals by synthetic review date and identifies evidence to verify before action.

intelligence_processing.name: Demand-consolidation analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares fragmented facility demand, supplier counts, combined spend, and tradeoffs to identify structured sourcing-review candidates.

intelligence_processing.name: Purchase-timing sequencing
intelligence_processing.detail: Sequences Northstar, MedSupply, and CareTech reviews with demand, competition, storage, warranty, and cash-flow checks.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Procurement managers, category buyers, and finance directors invoke four bounded operations through a Draft conversational agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file RAPP agent runs locally through Brainstem chat surfaces using bundled evidence and no customer credentials.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Teams sourcing review
clients_user_interface.detail: Teams is the curated collaboration surface for an authorized category manager to review evidence and decide approved next steps.

management_reporting.name: Savings Opportunity Scan
management_reporting.detail: Reports opportunity IDs, categories, suppliers, exact terms, thresholds, and gaps, with review-candidate and approval labels.

management_reporting.name: Time-Sensitive Pricing Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic review dates, pricing signals, and source notices that require verification through approved procurement.

management_reporting.name: Demand Consolidation Candidates
management_reporting.detail: Reports facilities, current supplier counts, combined spend, review candidates, and sourcing tradeoffs without recommending an award.

management_reporting.name: Purchase Timing Review
management_reporting.detail: Reports a sequenced sourcing-review brief with verified-term and alternative checks for an authorized category manager.

tools.name: ProcurementSupportAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable Python BasicAgent exposes four deterministic Discount Finder operations over the fixed synthetic evidence snapshot.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, and health surfaces.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the Draft agent, two uploaded knowledge files, four operation skills, and locked preview validation.

tools.name: Dynamics 365
tools.detail: Curated production seam for approved contract and forecast evidence; the packaged solution has no live connection or write action.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Supports human sourcing review after analysis; the agent does not contact suppliers, send notifications, or place purchases.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies the model used for natural-language routing and grounded presentation of tool results.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic snapshot
supporting_features.detail: Only packaged records and four skills are authoritative; browsing, live pricing, enrichment, and invented commercial facts are forbidden.

supporting_features.name: Explicit four-operation routing
supporting_features.detail: Natural-language intent maps only to savings scan, dated pricing, demand consolidation, or purchase-timing review.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic evidence and calculations
supporting_features.detail: Locked IDs, dates, categories, evidence sources, and gap formulas make each review output reproducible and traceable.

supporting_features.name: Sourcing-review boundary
supporting_features.detail: Outputs stop at review candidates and briefs: no supplier selection or contact, quote action, order, renewal, or spend commitment.

supporting_features.name: Authorized human decision gate
supporting_features.detail: An authorized category manager and approved procurement process retain all sourcing, timing, validation, and commercial decisions.

supporting_features.name: Locked four-case validation
supporting_features.detail: One persona-language case per operation passed strict Brainstem isolation and Copilot Studio preview with required evidence anchors.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publish separation
supporting_features.detail: Validated Copilot Studio artifacts remain unpublished in Draft; production connections and publication require explicit approval.
